svg.text: Real participants, recognizable symbols, and one central converter application
Original projects, XML, Java and libraries
Shared reuse and native Java generation
How to read: numbered links describe the main exchanges around the converter; double arrows mean requests and returned results.
Database cylinders = structured state/metadata. Folders = source, maps and artifact files. Deployment is a user action.
Default: fact collection/validation OFF · AST/source analysis ON · AI-generated tests and mocks ON · compatible shared work reused.
